# Talus

Talus is a gaming discovery platform at https://talus.social/. It organizes concise linked gaming-news briefs, esports information, free-game offers, patch histories, release dates, game information and community ratings.

## Main sections

- Home and gaming news: https://talus.social/
- Esports: https://talus.social/esports
- Free games: https://talus.social/free-games
- Game patches: https://talus.social/game-patch
- Release calendar: https://talus.social/game-calendar
- Game information and community ratings: https://talus.social/reviews

## Trust and policy

- About: https://talus.social/about
- Editorial standards: https://talus.social/editorial-standards
- Corrections policy: https://talus.social/corrections
- Content guidelines: https://talus.social/guidelines
- Privacy policy: https://talus.social/privacy

News briefs identify and link to the original publication. The linked source remains authoritative for an aggregated story. Community reviews are separately labeled.
